plan_amounts_nonnegative.name: plan_amounts_nonnegative
plan_amounts_nonnegative.value: "bill_funding_plans"."bill_amount_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."eligible_savings_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."eligible_contributions_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."eligible_vouchers_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."other_eligible_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."eligible_insurance_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."total_eligible_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."allocated_minor">=0 AND "bill_funding_plans"."shortfall_minor">=0

funding_kind_valid.name: funding_kind_valid
funding_kind_valid.value: ("funding_payments"."kind"='deposit' AND "funding_payments"."support_link_id" IS NULL AND "funding_payments"."payer_user_id"="funding_payments"."beneficiary_user_id") OR ("funding_payments"."kind"='contribution' AND "funding_payments"."support_link_id" IS NOT NULL AND "funding_payments"."goal_id" IS NULL)

funding_confirmation_valid.name: funding_confirmation_valid
funding_confirmation_valid.value: ("funding_payments"."status"='confirmed') = ("funding_payments"."journal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "funding_payments"."allocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "funding_payments"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

account_allocation_bucket_valid.name: account_allocation_bucket_valid
account_allocation_bucket_valid.value: ("ledger_accounts"."allocation_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."bucket" IS NULL) OR ("ledger_accounts"."allocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."bucket" IN ('available','reserved','pending','restricted') AND "ledger_accounts"."normal_side"='credit' AND "ledger_accounts"."kind"='liability' AND NOT "ledger_accounts"."allow_negative")

settlement_confirmation_evidence.name: settlement_confirmation_evidence
settlement_confirmation_evidence.value: "partner_settlements"."status"<>'confirmed' OR ("partner_settlements"."partner_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_settlements"."evidence" IS NOT NULL AND "partner_settlements"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)
